options.text: The bacterium is a complete living organism even though it has only one cell.
The bacterium can carry out the functions needed for survival in its single cell.
The skin cell from her hand is itself a complete organism because it is one cell.

stem:
Ayesha views a bacterium under a microscope. It is one cell and carries out all survival functions in that cell. She also looks at a single skin cell scraped from her own hand.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: A unicellular organism such as a bacterium is a complete living organism because one cell carries out all survival functions. An isolated skin cell from a multicellular body is not a complete organism, and not every microorganism is unicellular.
